Name: (CP) Floral Foods
Author: KatsAtelier
Description: Once you have been to Oasis (Sandy's shop), after a day or two you'll get a letter with one recipe and a quest, complete the quest and wait a couple days for a second letter, then you can buy the other 4 recipes this mod adds from Gus at the Saloon. Includes gift tastes.
